name: menthol + tolnaftate
uses: Use Wet Wipes to help reduce microbes that potentially can cause disease. For use when soap and water are not available. Also can be used for treat skin disease caused by fungus, such as jock itch, athlete's foot or ringworm.
otcwarn: Do not use in children less than 2 months of age on open skin wounds You are known to be allergy to any ingredients. Stop use and ask a doctor if irritation or rash occurs. These may be signs of a serious condition.
